hook: Lattice QCD puts the nucleon light sigma term at 53.0 MeV, with a 7.4 MeV statistical error.

readout.label: Nucleon light sigma term, lattice QCD

summary: Simulations with four lattice spacings at physical pion mass are extrapolated to the continuum, giving the light, strange and charm sigma terms of the nucleon, which measure how quark masses contribute to nucleon mass. The strange value is 58.2 MeV and the charm value is 112 MeV. The charm term has a large uncertainty, about 28 MeV statistical.
title: Nucleon sigma terms in lattice QCD at physical pion mass and in the continuum
